title: Let the AI pick a translation better than the "right answer"
description: "Prepare one correct set of model answers and have the model imitate them" — that's the conventional wisdom in AI training. But have the teacher produce N candidates and let a quality estimator (QE) pick the best, and you get model answers that beat the teacher's first shot — the "next move" I expect the most from in LYR. And what I'm sure of is the flip side: if the yardstick you select with is off target, you lose outright to one clean set of model answers (measured: 82% → 73–77%).
